title: 100,000 Yuan for One Character
synopsis: The National Museum of Chinese Writing is offering a great reward for deciphering oracle bone inscriptions.

fullText.simplified:
一个字十万元

    认出一个字给你10万元。别不相信，这是真事！
    最近，中国文字博物馆发出“悬赏”：破译未解读的甲骨文，一个字奖励10万元！
    要想拿到这10万元，首先我们要了解什么是甲骨文。甲骨文是中国的一种古代文字，被称为“最早的汉字”，还有人认为，中国的书法是从甲骨文开始的。因为文字是写在龟甲和兽骨上的，所以叫做“甲骨文”。甲骨文距现在有3千多年的历史，它记录和反映了中国商朝的政治和经济情况。目前发现的甲骨文大约有4000到5000个字，虽然研究者对甲骨文的研究已经有一百多年了，但现在能释读的甲骨文只有约1500个，还有约3500个甲骨文待破译。
    也就是说，如果你能破译出这3500个甲骨文，一个字奖励10万元，那么你就可以得到3亿5千万元了！当然，这钱也不是那么好拿的。简单地说，你不但要认出甲骨文，还要写报告说明你的研究成果，然后经专家委员会鉴定通过后，才能得到奖励。
    怎么样，你想试试吗？
fullText.traditional:
一個字十萬元

    認出一個字給你10萬元。別不相信，這是真事！
    最近，中國文字博物館發出“懸賞”：破譯未解讀的甲骨文，一個字獎勵10萬元！
    要想拿到這10萬元，首先我們要了解什麼是甲骨文。甲骨文是中國的一種古代文字，被稱為“最早的漢字”，還有人認為，中國的書法是從甲骨文開始的。因為文字是寫在龜甲和獸骨上的，所以叫做“甲骨文”。甲骨文距現在有3千多年的歷史，它記錄和反映了中國商朝的政治和經濟情況。目前發現的甲骨文大約有4000到5000個字，雖然研究者對甲骨文的研究已經有一百多年了，但現在能釋讀的甲骨文只有約1500個，還有約3500個甲骨文待破譯。
    也就是說，如果你能破譯出這3500個甲骨文，一個字獎勵10萬元，那麼你就可以得到3億5千萬元了！當然，這錢也不是那麼好拿的。簡單地說，你不但要認出甲骨文，還要寫報告說明你的研究成果，然後經專家委員會鑑定通過後，才能得到獎勵。
    怎麼樣，你想試試嗎？

raw.synopsis: The National Museum of Chinese Writing is offering a great reward for deciphering oracle bone inscriptions.
sentence_translations: 100,000 Yuan for One Character
Recognize a character and you will get a hundred thousand yuan.
You better believe it, this is true!
Recently, the National Museum Of Chinese Writing offered a “reward”:
Decode undeciphered oracle bone inscriptions, and be rewarded 100,000 yuan per character!
If we want to seize the 100,000 yuan, first we need to know what oracle bone inscriptions are.
Oracle bone inscriptions are ancient Chinese writings known as the “earliest Chinese characters”.
Some people believe that Chinese calligraphy originated from oracle bone inscriptions.
It is called “oracle bone inscription” because the characters were carved on tortoise shells and animal bones.
Oracle bone inscriptions have a history of more than three thousand years.
They record and reflect the political and economic conditions of the Shang Dynasty.
Approximately 4,000 to 5,000 characters have been found in oracle bone inscriptions so far.
Even though researchers have studied oracle bone inscriptions for over a hundred years, ..
.. only about 1,500 characters have been deciphered so far, and roughly 3,500 characters are yet to be deciphered.
This means that if you are able to decipher all 3,500 characters, and get 100,000 yuan per character, ..
.. then you can get 350 million yuan!
Of course, this money is not that easy to get.
Put simply, not only must you recognize the inscriptions, you must also write a report explaining your research results.
After that, your findings must be approved by an expert committee, and only then will the money be yours.
So what do you think? Want to give it a try?
